name: Business and Leadership Program (UW Foster School of Business)
org: University of Washington Foster School of Business with Summer Springboard
what_you_do: This is a two-week summer program on the UW Seattle campus. It has leadership workshops. You join a real-world business case competition. You visit two Seattle companies.
who_can_apply: High school students (page lists rising 10th, 11th and 12th graders and graduating seniors; no age range stated). No business experience required. Summer Springboard lists a 3.0 GPA.
pay_detail: Summer Springboard's 2027 tuition: commuter $4,498 (lunch, a course, excursions, 9am to 5pm Monday to Friday), residential $7,898, plus a $600 deposit and a $99+ application fee. The Foster page says final pricing is coming soon. Commuters can join weekend excursions for $125 per day. Financial aid is not mentioned on the page.
duration: 2 weeks (2027 sessions: July 11 to 23 and Aug 1 to 13)
deadline_text: Summer Springboard says it is taking 2027 applications. Final deadline May 16, 2027. Some programs may fill sooner (first wave Feb 21, 2027). Tuition rises Dec 1, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply through partner Summer Springboard's online portal (Apply now link on the page). Program questions go to the program contact listed on the page.
notes: Expensive paid pre-college program from a real university. The page says students can attend both experiences during a single extended stay, but it does not name a one-week Business Startup Bootcamp. Summer Springboard's calendar is headed Summer 2026 but lists 2027 dates, so confirm the deadline.
